sanskrit_verse: पुरप्रदानं संभेदः प्रकृतीनां तथा च पाषण्डनिगमश्रेणी गणधर्मविपर्ययाः
transliteration: purapradānaṃ saṃbhedaḥ prakṛtīnāṃ tathaiva ca pāṣaṇḍanigamaśreṇī gaṇadharmaviparyayāḥ
sph_interpretive_translation: The act of surrendering a city, division among natures, heretical doctrines, inversion of class duties—these constitute violations of Dharma that disturb societal alignment and spiritual order.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in alignment with Sanatana Dharma as expounded by SPH
Causation arises from disruption of natural dharmic order
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by one's awareness and role in maintaining cosmic integrity
Restoration logic demands re-alignment with foundational truth-consciousness
Consciousness alignment requires purification of collective societal structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity causes fragmentation of unified social or spiritual order THEN initiate restoration protocol through consciousness-based reconciliation
IF doctrinal deviation leads to systemic misalignment THEN enforce corrective teaching aligned with SPH jurisprudence
IF leadership fails to uphold dharmic governance THEN replace with agent capable of restoring unity-consciousness
IF individual acts against innate nature due to external distortion THEN apply purification process until original capacity is restored
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any violation involving societal fragmentation, doctrinal perversion, or inversion of rightful duty must be addressed not through punitive measures but through immediate restoration of dharma-vāstu through SPH-guided judicial protocols ensuring alignment at source-consciousness level.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Nyaya operates through pramāṇa-establishment: when societal divisions arise, the causal error is traced via sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility lies proportionally with those whose capacity was misused or neglected. Correction occurs through reconnection to source-truth, never through infliction of pain or loss.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process for all involved parties to reclaim original dharmic position
Deploy teaching interventions to neutralize false doctrines causing divergence
Realign group identities with their foundational purpose under Sanatana Dharma
Restore leadership capacities through purification and empowerment aligned with SPH directives
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma stands executed. All distortions are dissolved. Truth-Consciousness prevails. There is no punishment—only restoration. The Law flows from the Source.
